refinements.name: 热血施工
refinements.description: 位于后场时，装备者的能量自动回复提升0.6点/秒；发动[强化特殊技]时，装备者的冲击力提升10%，最多叠加2层，持续10秒，每层效果单独结算持续时间。
refinements.descriptionEn:
While off-field, the equipper's Energy Regen increases by 0.6/s.
When using an EX Special Attack, the equipper's Impact is increased by 10% for 10s, stacking up to 2 times. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

refinements.name: 热血施工

basic.name: 普通攻击：砸扁，粉碎
basic.trigger: 点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多四段的打击，造成物理伤害；
当珂蕾妲拥有[熔炉升温]效果时，能够在第二段攻击后发动强化[普通攻击]，消耗[熔炉升温]效果并造成大量火属性伤害；
当珂蕾妲与本同时出战，发动强化[普通攻击]时，会由双方配合发动协同攻击，进一步提升招式的威力；
[普通攻击]第四段和强化[普通攻击]发动期间拥有无敌效果。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to 4 strikes, dealing Physical DMG.
When Koleda has the Furnace Fire effect, she can launch an enhanced Basic Attack after the 2nd hit, consuming the Furnace Fire effect and dealing massive Fire DMG.
When Koleda and Ben are deployed together, executing an enhanced Basic Attack will trigger a coordinated attack from both, further increasing the move's power;
Koleda is invulnerable during the Basic Attack's 4th hit and enhanced Basic Attack.

special.name: 特殊技：爆破！铁锤时间
special.trigger: 点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
special.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
对前方进行打击并引发爆炸，造成火属性伤害；
若衔接在[普通攻击]第二、第四段或强化[普通攻击]后，则能够快速发动招式，直接引发爆炸；
当珂蕾妲与本同时出战，并衔接在强化[普通攻击]后快速发动招式时，会由双方配合发动协同攻击，进一步提升招式的威力；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升。
special.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Strikes enemies in front and triggers an explosion, dealing Fire DMG.
This skill launches faster and triggers an explosion when used after the 2nd or 4th hit of Koleda's Basic Attack or enhanced Basic Attack.
When Koleda and Ben are both in your squad, and this skill is quickly launched after an enhanced Basic Attack, they team up to launch a coordinated attack, further increasing the power of the skill.
Anti-Interrupt level is increased while using this skill.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：沸腾熔炉
ex.trigger: 能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
ex.triggerEn: With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
ex.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
对前方进行打击并引发强力爆炸，造成大量火属性伤害，并获得[熔炉升温]效果；
若衔接在[普通攻击]第二、第四段或强化[普通攻击]后，则能够快速发动招式，直接引发爆炸；
当珂蕾妲与本同时出战，并衔接在强化[普通攻击]后快速发动招式时，会由双方配合发动协同攻击，进一步提升招式的威力；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Strikes enemies in front and triggers a powerful explosion, dealing massive Fire DMG. Koleda also gains the Furnace Fire effect.
This skill activates faster and triggers an explosion when used after the 2nd or 4th hit of Koleda's Basic Attack or enhanced Basic Attack.
When Koleda and Ben are both in your squad and this skill is quickly launched after an enhanced Basic Attack, they team up to launch a coordinated attack, further increasing the power of the skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

dodgeCounter.name: 闪避反击：别小看我
dodgeCounter.nameEn: Dodge Counter: Don't Look Down on Me
dodgeCounter.trigger: 触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
dodgeCounter.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
dodgeCounter.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方敌人发动打击并引发爆炸，造成火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
dodgeCounter.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Strikes enemies in front and creates an explosion, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

chain.name: 连携技：天崩-地裂
chain.trigger: 触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
chain.triggerEn: When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
chain.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
在前方大范围区域发动强力爆炸，造成大量火属性伤害，并获得[熔炉升温]效果；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
chain.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleashes a powerful explosion on enemies in a large area, dealing massive Fire DMG while also obtaining the Furnace Fire effect.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ultimate.name: 终结技：锤进地心
ultimate.trigger: 喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
ultimate.triggerEn: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
在前方大范围区域发动强力爆炸，造成大量火属性伤害，并获得[熔炉升温]效果；
当珂蕾妲与本同时出战时，会由双方配合发动协同攻击，进一步提升招式的威力；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Unleashes a powerful explosion on enemies in a large area in front, dealing massive Fire DMG while also obtaining the Furnace Fire effect.
Koleda and Ben can team up when fighting together to launch a coordinated attack, further increasing the power of the attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：让我来
quickAssist.trigger: 当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
quickAssist.triggerEn: When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
向前方敌人发动打击，造成火属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Strikes enemies in front, dealing Fire DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

defensiveAssist.name: 招架支援：护身锤
defensiveAssist.trigger: 前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
defensiveAssist.triggerEn: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
defensiveAssist.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
具有较为优秀的招架性能，承受高强度攻击时[支援点数]的消耗量降低；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
defensiveAssist.descriptionEn:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of Assist Points when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

assistFollowup.name: 支援突击：锤钟
assistFollowup.trigger: 发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
assistFollowup.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
assistFollowup.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动突进打击，造成火属性伤害，并获得[熔炉升温]效果；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
assistFollowup.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Koleda charges and strikes enemies in front, dealing Fire DMG and obtaining Furnace Fire effect.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

facts.text: 珂蕾妲发动[强化特殊技]，或消耗[熔炉升温]发动强化[普通攻击]时，招式造成的失衡值提升60%。
facts.textEn: When Koleda uses her EX Special Attack or consumes Furnace Fire to use an enhanced Basic Attack, the Daze she deals increases by 60%.

cinema.name: 锤击节奏
cinema.description: 当衔接在[普通攻击]第二、第四段或强化[普通攻击]后，快速发动[特殊技]或[强化特殊技]时，招式造成的失衡值提升15%。
cinema.descriptionEn: After the 2nd or 4th hit of Koleda's Basic Attack or her enhanced Basic Attack, quickly use a Special Attack or EX Special Attack to increase the Daze dealt by 15%.

cinema.name: 动能回收
cinema.description: [强化特殊技]命中敌人时，珂蕾妲回复60点能量，45秒内最多触发一次。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Koleda's EX Special Attack hits an enemy, she recovers 60 Energy. Can trigger once every 45s.

cinema.name: 「别惹我！」
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 熔炉余温
cinema.description: 消耗[熔炉升温]发动强化[普通攻击]时，珂蕾妲获得1层充能（上限2层）；[连携技：天崩-地裂]或[终结技：锤进地心]命中敌人时，消耗所有充能，每层充能使当前招式造成的伤害提升18%。
cinema.descriptionEn: Koleda gains one stack of Charge (max 2 stacks) when consuming Furnace Fire to use her Enhanced Basic Attack. When her Chain Attack: Natural Disaster or Ultimate: Hammerquake hits an enemy, she consumes all stacks of Charge to increase the attack's DMG by 18% per stack.

cinema.name: 「敢小瞧我？」
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 饱和爆破
cinema.description: 在[强化特殊技]、[连携技]或[终结技]中，引发爆炸命中敌人时，额外造成珂蕾妲360%攻击力的伤害。
cinema.descriptionEn: When EX Special Attack, Chain Attack, or Ultimate triggers an explosion that hits an enemy, it deals additional DMG equal to 360% of Koleda's ATK.
